ADDED i2: Tests for {@link DefaultParser}, focusing on its various {@code parse(...)} overloads, its builder, and a few protected helper methods.

The class under test
ADDED i3: Fully qualified name of the class under test, used in exception assertions.
ADDED i4: Parsing "-s" for a required option group selects that group, both via the group instance and the (identical) instance returned by addOption.
ADDED i5: Parsing "-s" with the matching option present yields a non-null CommandLine.
ADDED i6: A parser built with quote stripping set to {@code false} parses an option "-s" followed by its argument value.
ADDED i7: Boolean.valueOf("s") is false: quote stripping disabled.
ADDED i8: With quote stripping enabled and stopAtNonOption true, an option argument containing quote-like characters is parsed successfully.
ADDED i9: An argument that does not look like a known option is accepted (added as a plain argument) when stopAtNonOption is true.
ADDED i10: Parsing with an empty Properties object and a single argument succeeds.
ADDED i11: Parsing a null argument array is allowed and yields an empty CommandLine.
ADDED i12: An option taking an argument is parsed together with its trailing value.
ADDED i13: An option that requires an argument but is followed by another option ("-s") fails with a missing-argument error.
ADDED i15: Same missing-argument failure as above, with an additional long-only option "s" registered alongside the short option that requires an argument.
ADDED i17: A lone "-" following "-s" is accepted as that option's argument value.
ADDED i18: With the IGNORE non-option action set, {@code handleUnknownToken} silently ignores an unknown "-T" token without throwing.
ADDED i19: A lone "-" token is treated as a plain argument, not an option.
ADDED i20: The "--" token marks the end of options and is handled without error.
ADDED i21: Plain (non-dash) tokens are accepted as arguments by a builder-created parser.
ADDED i22: With partial matching disabled, a "-c=wt9" token whose name does not match the registered option key is reported as unrecognized.
ADDED i24: A required option that accepts an argument is parsed from a "-c=wt9" token via its long name.
ADDED i25: With no options registered but stopAtNonOption true, an unrecognized "-c=wt9" token does not fail; parsing stops and returns a CommandLine.
ADDED i26: A required option that needs an argument but is given none ("-s4" alone) fails with a missing-argument error.
ADDED i28: Supplying properties that reference an option which was never defined triggers a "Default option wasn't defined" error.
ADDED i30: A required option provided via its long form "--s" is parsed successfully.
ADDED i31: With stopAtNonOption false, an unrecognized "-=};SP'" token (that does not match the registered "--s4" option) raises an unrecognized-option error.
ADDED i33: A Java-property style option ("-=};SP'" matching "js4") is parsed when the token appears among the arguments.
ADDED i34: When a token could match two long options, parsing reports an ambiguous option error.
ADDED i36: A "---..." token that matches no option, parsed without stopAtNonOption, raises an unrecognized-option error.
ADDED i38: A short option with a trailing value attached ("-s#") is parsed as the option "s" plus its argument when stopAtNonOption is false.
ADDED i39: A concatenated short-option token "-s-#\"J" against an argument-less option "s" is parsed (the extra characters are handled as unknown but tolerated with stopAt
ADDED i40: With no options registered and stopAtNonOption false, the unknown "-s#" token raises an unrecognized-option error.
ADDED i42: With no options registered but stopAtNonOption true, an unknown "-s-#\"J" token does not fail; parsing returns a CommandLine.
ADDED i43: After a parse run, {@code handleConcatenatedOptions} can be invoked directly with "-s" and completes without throwing.
ADDED i44: A required option supplied via its long form "--s4" is parsed successfully by a parser with partial matching disabled.
ADDED i45: With partial matching disabled and no matching option, a "--kfS14..." token supplied alongside properties raises an unrecognized-option error.
ADDED i47: A required option that is never supplied on the command line raises a missing-required-option error.
ADDED i49: The builder's {@code setDeprecatedHandler} is fluent: it returns the same builder instance.
ADDED i50: An option "s" requiring an argument, given "-s" followed (after a gap) by another option-like token "-s#", fails with a missing-argument error.
ADDED i52: Passing null options causes a NullPointerException from Objects.requireNonNull.
ADDED i54: With no options registered but stopAtNonOption true, a "-s" token is tolerated and parsing returns a CommandLine.
